(#{item.menuId}, #{item.targetType}, #{item.targetId}, #{item.tenantId}, 0, NOW())

INSERT INTO sys_menu_permission ( menu_id, target_type, target_id, tenant_id, deleted, create_time ) SELECT child.id AS menu_id, parent_perm.target_type, parent_perm.target_id, parent_perm.tenant_id, 0, NOW() FROM sys_menu_permission parent_perm INNER JOIN sys_menu child ON child.parent_id = #{parentMenuId} WHERE parent_perm.deleted = 0 AND child.deleted = 0 AND parent_perm.menu_id = #{parentMenuId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_menu_permission existing WHERE existing.deleted = 0 AND existing.menu_id = child.id AND existing.target_type = parent_perm.target_type AND existing.target_id = parent_perm.target_id )
